title: ios/scripts/test.sh turns sim-run's exit 75 (load guard give-up) into FAILED; it should pass it through as "not run: load guard"
evidence: Done by PR 1299 (1592d758f): ios/scripts/test.sh keeps sim-run's exit code in build/sim-run-status and exits 75 with "NOT RUN in <zone>" (test.sh:34-37); PR 1313 (6ffd43677) matched US-71 AC8; PRs 1621 and 1637 kept it across both zones. Was: ios/scripts/test.sh:19-23 pipes sim-run through tee and grep with || true, then greps the log for TEST SUCCEEDED, so a load-guard give-up (exit 75, US-71 AC8) prints "FAILED in <zone>" with the sim-run line above it. Owner: UI
